description: A watchlist with a tiny gradient area chart beside each price, colored by whether the stock is rising or falling.
overview: Each row renders a `Sparkline` component: a compact `ChartContainer` (`h-8 w-18`) holding an `AreaChart` with one `Area` (`type="linear"`, `strokeWidth={1.5}`, `dot={false}`) and a hidden `YAxis` with `domain={["dataMin", "dataMax"]}` so small moves fill the height. There is no grid, x-axis or tooltip. Data comes from `series(seed, rising)`, a seeded generator that returns 30 `{ index, value }` points. `chartConfig` defines `up` (`var(--success)`) and `down` (`var(--danger)`), and each sparkline picks one based on the sign of `stock.change`. Each gradient fill uses an id from `React.useId()`.
usage: Replace the `stocks` array with your own symbols, prices and changes, and pass real price history to the chart in place of `series(...)`, keeping an `index` and a `value` field. Change the `up` and `down` colors in `chartConfig` to restyle the trend. The sparkline size is set by the `ChartContainer` `className`.
notes: Each sparkline is decorative: `ChartContainer` is `aria-hidden` and `accessibilityLayer={false}`, so the symbol, price and percentage text carry the information. Animation is turned off with `isAnimationActive={false}`.
